title.rendered: Lamborghini Towed from Red Deer to Calgary: A Job That Demanded Precision

content.raw:
When it comes to exotic cars, no two tows are ever the same. This Lamborghini recovery from Red Deer to Calgary was a perfect example of why experience matters.

The Call

It was around 9:00 PM when our team received a call about a Lamborghini stranded in Red Deer with a flat tire. The car could no longer be driven safely, and after weighing the options, the customer decided the best move was to have the vehicle transported all the way back to Calgary rather than risk driving it any further.

This is exactly the kind of situation where reliable 24 hour towing Calgary support makes all the difference. Problems like this rarely happen at a convenient time, and having a team ready to respond at 9 PM on a moment's notice is what separates a good towing company from an average one.

Why Low-Clearance Exotics Are a Different Challenge

Lamborghinis sit extremely low to the ground, far lower than the average sedan or SUV, and even lower than most other sports cars. That kind of ground clearance leaves almost no room for error when loading onto a flatbed. A rushed or careless approach can easily result in scraping, denting, or damaging the undercarriage.

Our crew carefully positioned the flatbed, took extra time during the loading process, and made sure nothing made contact with the ground or the deck. Every angle, every incline, and every inch of clearance had to be accounted for before the vehicle was secured for transport.

Delivered Safely, Without a Scratch

Once properly loaded and secured, the Lamborghini was transported from Red Deer to Calgary and delivered without a single scratch. This is exactly the outcome any owner of a high-value vehicle expects and deserves.

This job is a reminder that not all towing is created equal. Low-clearance, high-value, and exotic vehicles require specialized equipment, patience, and hands-on experience. Not just any tow truck near me will do the job right.

Why Choose BP Towing Service

At BP Towing Service, we understand that a call for help is often stressful, especially when it involves a vehicle as valuable as a Lamborghini. Whether you need standard roadside help or a specialized towing company Calgary drivers trust with exotic and luxury cars, our team has the equipment and expertise to get your vehicle where it needs to go, safely and without damage.

From emergency roadside assistance to long-distance vehicle transport, we treat every car, whether it's a daily driver or a six-figure supercar, with the same level of care and attention to detail.

Need towing in Calgary or the surrounding area? Contact BP Towing Service any time, day or night, for fast, professional, and careful towing you can count on.

Frequently Asked Questions

1. Do you offer 24/7 emergency towing in Calgary? Yes, we provide round-the-clock emergency towing and roadside assistance across Calgary and surrounding areas, including Red Deer, any time of day or night.

2. Can you tow low-clearance and exotic cars like Lamborghinis? Absolutely. Our team is experienced in handling low-clearance sports cars and exotic vehicles, using specialized flatbeds and careful loading techniques to avoid any damage.

3. How fast can a tow truck reach me in Calgary? Response times vary depending on your location and traffic, but our team prioritizes urgent and emergency calls to get to you as quickly as possible.

4. Do you provide long-distance towing, such as from Red Deer to Calgary? Yes, we handle long-distance vehicle transport, including trips like Red Deer to Calgary, with the same level of care as local tows.

5. Is my vehicle insured during transport? Yes, we take full precautions and use proper securing techniques to make sure your vehicle, whether it's a daily driver or a luxury car, reaches its destination safely and without damage.

6. How do I book a tow truck near me in Calgary? Simply call BP Towing Service or reach out through our website, and our nearest available driver will be dispatched to your location right away.

title.rendered: Stranded at Rush Hour: How BP Towing Rescued a Volvo SUV on Deerfoot Trail

content.raw:
A Volvo SUV broke down on northbound Deerfoot Trail (between Peigan Trail and 17th Avenue SE) during rush hour. BP Towing Service arrived in approximately 10 minutes, moved the customer to safety, and transported the vehicle to Fountain Tire on Macleod Trail SW for repair. Need towing on Deerfoot Trail? Call BP Towing Service 24/7 at (403) 991-2265.

Highway breakdowns are stressful under any circumstances but when your vehicle stalls in the middle of Calgary's busiest rush-hour traffic, every minute matters. That's exactly the situation one of our customers found herself in this week, and it's a perfect example of why fast, reliable towing can make all the difference.

The Situation

At around 5:00 PM, right in the thick of evening rush hour, a Volvo SUV broke down while travelling northbound on Deerfoot Trail between Peigan Trail and 17th Avenue SE one of the busiest and most dangerous stretches of highway in the city to be stranded on. With traffic moving at highway speed all around her, the customer had little choice but to call for help immediately.

A Fast Response When It Mattered Most

She called BP Towing Service, and our emergency towing Calgary team arrived on scene in approximately 10 minutes a critical response time given how heavy the traffic was that evening. On a road like Deerfoot Trail during rush hour, every extra minute stranded on the shoulder increases the risk, so getting there quickly was the priority from the moment the call came in.

Safety First

Before anything else, our driver advised the customer to move away from the side of the highway to somewhere safer while we prepared to load her vehicle. Fortunately, her husband was nearby in another vehicle, so she was able to get to safety with him while our team took care of the rest the kind of roadside assistance Calgary drivers can count on any time of day.

Getting the Vehicle Where It Needed to Go

With the customer safely out of harm's way, we carefully loaded the Volvo onto our flatbed and transported it to Fountain Tire at 7007 Macleod Trail SW, near Glenmore Trail, where it could be properly assessed and repaired.

Why It Matters

This call is a good reminder of what roadside breakdowns on major routes like Deerfoot Trail actually demand: speed, safety awareness, and a calm, experienced team. From the first phone call to the moment the vehicle was dropped off for repairs, our goal was simple get the customer out of danger and get her vehicle where it needed to be, without delay.

Frequently Asked Questions

What should I do if my car breaks down on Deerfoot Trail during rush hour?

Turn on your hazard lights, avoid exiting the vehicle into moving traffic, and call a towing service immediately. If it's safe to do so, wait for help away from the flow of traffic for example, with a companion in a following vehicle, as in this case.

How fast does BP Towing respond to breakdowns on Deerfoot Trail?

In this case, BP Towing Service arrived in approximately 10 minutes despite heavy rush-hour traffic. Response times vary by location and traffic conditions, but BP Towing dispatches immediately upon receiving a call, 24 hours a day.

Does BP Towing operate 24/7 in Calgary?

Yes. BP Towing Service provides towing and roadside assistance across Calgary, including North and West Calgary, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including holidays and severe weather.

Where does BP Towing take vehicles for repair?

BP Towing can transport vehicles to any Calgary repair shop, dealership, or address the customer chooses. In this case, the vehicle was taken to Fountain Tire at 7007 Macleod Trail SW.

How do I contact BP Towing Service for an emergency tow?

Call (403) 991-2265, available 24/7 for emergency towing anywhere in Calgary and surrounding areas including Airdrie, Chestermere, and Cochrane.

Stranded on Deerfoot Trail or anywhere else in Calgary?

BP Towing Service is a 24/7 Calgary towing company offering fast dispatch across North and West Calgary and surrounding areas. Call (403) 991-2265 any time, day or night.

The Job: A Honda Odyssey Left Behind at the Calgary Zoo

A customer left their black Honda Odyssey minivan in the parking lot at the Calgary Zoo, in the northeast part of the city. The vehicle needed to be picked up and delivered across town to Calgary Honda, the dealership located on Lake Fraser Drive in the southeast.

There was one complication: no key was available for the vehicle. That meant our team couldn't simply start the van and drive it away, or even unlock the steering column the normal way. This is a situation that comes up more often than people expect — a lost key, a key left inside a locked vehicle, or a customer who simply doesn't have access to the key at the time of pickup. Whatever the reason, it still needs to be handled safely and professionally.

How We Towed It Without a Key

Since the Honda Odyssey is a front-wheel-drive vehicle, our operator used a wrecker tow truck to pick the van up from the front end. The wrecker's lift arm and wheel cradles secured the front wheels which are also the drive wheels on a front-wheel-drive vehicle and lifted them completely off the ground.

This is the key detail that makes towing without a key possible: because the drive wheels never touch the road during transport, the vehicle doesn't need to be started, steered, or unlocked. The rear wheels simply roll freely behind the truck while the front end stays secured and elevated on the wrecker. This method also protects the transmission and drivetrain from unnecessary wear, which is important on any front-wheel-drive vehicle like the Odyssey.

Our driver checked every chain and strap before hitting the road, then made the trip from the Calgary Zoo parking lot in the northeast, across the city, to Calgary Honda on Lake Fraser Drive in the southeast. title.rendered: Hailstorm Damage: What to Do If Your Car Is Stuck After an Alberta Hailstorm

content.raw:
If your car won't start, has a shattered windshield, or is stuck in flooded or hail-covered roads after an Alberta storm, move to safety first, then call a local towing company for a flatbed tow don't attempt to drive a vehicle with storm damage, as this can worsen mechanical or structural issues.

Calgary sits inside what meteorologists call "Hail Alley" the stretch of southern Alberta that sees more severe hailstorms than almost anywhere else in Canada. Every summer, from late June through September, sudden hailstorms roll through neighbourhoods like Airdrie, Chestermere, and southeast Calgary, leaving dented hoods, shattered windshields, and drivers stranded on the side of the road. If you've just been caught in one, here's exactly what to do.

Why Hailstorms Strand Vehicles in Calgary

Hail doesn't just dent metal. It can:

  • Crack or shatter windshields and rear windows, making a vehicle unsafe to drive
  • Damage sensors, cameras, and antennas on newer vehicles (especially EVs and luxury cars)
  • Cause drivers to pull over suddenly on highways like Deerfoot Trail or Stoney Trail, sometimes in low-visibility conditions
  • Lead to flash flooding on underpasses, stalling engines that take on water

Any one of these situations can leave you stuck and in a bad storm, waiting it out on the shoulder isn't always safe either.

Step-by-Step: What to Do If You're Caught in a Hailstorm

1. Get to Shelter, Not Just Off the Road

If you're driving when hail starts, look for an overpass, parkade, or gas station canopy. Don't stop under trees or power lines.

2. Assess the Damage Before Driving Again

Even if the storm passes, don't assume your car is safe to drive. Check for:

  • Cracked windshield glass (a shattered windshield can fail completely under vibration)
  • Warning lights on the dashboard
  • Unusual sounds from the engine bay if water got in

3. Call for a Flatbed Tow, Not a Hook-and-Chain

Storm-damaged vehicles especially ones with cracked glass or electrical issues should always be moved on a flatbed. This avoids further stress on the frame or suspension. If your vehicle has any luxury or specialty trim, this matters even more; see our guide on specialty vehicle towing for how proper equipment protects your car during a tow (special vehicle towing).

4. Document Everything for Insurance

Before the tow truck arrives, take photos of:

  • Dents and cracked glass
  • Your location and road conditions
  • Any visible flooding, if applicable

Alberta insurers typically cover comprehensive hail damage, but photo evidence taken immediately speeds up your claim.

5. Don't Try to "Just Get It Home"

A lot of drivers try to limp a hail-damaged car home rather than call for help. This is risky if your windshield is compromised or your car stalled in water a stalled engine that's been flooded can suffer serious internal damage if restarted incorrectly.

What About Flooded Underpasses?

Calgary's summer storms often bring flash flooding, particularly on low-lying roads and underpasses. If your car stalls in standing water:

  • Do not restart the engine
  • Turn on your hazard lights
  • Call for a tow immediately a stalled vehicle in water needs proper recovery, not a jump start

When Hail Season Peaks in Alberta

Alberta's hail season generally runs from late spring through early fall, with July and August seeing the highest frequency of severe storms across the Calgary–Airdrie–Okotoks corridor. Keeping a towing company's number saved on your phone during these months is a smart habit for any Calgary driver.

How BP Towing Helps After a Storm

BP Towing Service runs 24/7 across Calgary and the surrounding 30-km radius, which means storm season doesn't slow down response times. Whether your vehicle needs a flatbed tow after hail damage, a jump start because your battery drained while you waited out a storm, or simply a safe transport to your mechanic, our team is dispatched quickly with transparent, upfront pricing no "storm surcharge" surprises. If you also need emergency jump start help after your battery drained during a long wait, check out our jump start service.

FAQs

Q: Should I drive my car after a hailstorm if it still starts? A: Only if there's no cracked glass, no warning lights, and no signs of water intrusion. If in doubt, call a tow truck rather than risk further damage.

Q: Does insurance cover towing after hail damage in Alberta? A: Most comprehensive auto insurance policies in Alberta cover hail damage, and many also cover towing costs if the vehicle is undrivable. Check your specific policy or ask your insurer directly.

Q: How fast can a tow truck reach me during a Calgary storm? A: BP Towing typically arrives within 20–35 minutes across Calgary neighbourhoods and major routes, even during active storm conditions.

Q: Can hail damage a car's electrical systems? A: Yes, especially in newer vehicles with roof-mounted sensors, antennas, or cameras. If your dashboard shows unusual warnings after a storm, have it inspected before driving further.

Q: What's the safest place to pull over during a hailstorm? A: An overpass, parkade, or covered gas station canopy never under trees, power lines, or on the open shoulder of a highway.

Need help after a storm? Contact BP Towing available 24/7 across Calgary.

content.raw:
Not every tow call starts with a breakdown on Deerfoot Trail or a car stuck in a snowbank. Sometimes the story is different and it's a good example of why Calgary dealerships trust BP Towing Service for more than just emergency calls.

The Job

Last week our flatbed crew picked up a 2025 Hyundai Elantra from IAA Calgary (Insurance Auto Auctions), one of the city's busiest salvage and dealer-return auction yards. The vehicle had been listed for sale at auction but didn't find a buyer this time.

When that happens, the owner or dealership has to arrange to retrieve it and that's where a professional flatbed towing team comes in. Our driver arrived in one of our flatbed tow trucks, safely winched the Elantra onto the deck, strapped it down, and got it ready for the road.

From there, the destination was a Hyundai dealership on Country Hills Boulevard NE delivered carefully and on schedule.

Why Dealerships Call Us

Auction and dealership towing isn't like a typical emergency tow. It requires:

  • Damage-free flatbed transport no dragging, no wheel-lift on a newer vehicle

title.raw: Broken Down on Highway 1 Near Kananaskis: How We Got a Subaru Forester Safely Back to Calgary
title.rendered: Broken Down on Highway 1 Near Kananaskis: How We Got a Subaru Forester Safely Back to Calgary

content.raw:
Not every breakdown happens in the city where help is five minutes away. Some of the calls we take at BP Towing come from the Trans-Canada Highway west of Calgary, where traffic moves fast, shoulders are narrow, and the nearest repair shop is a long way off. This recent tow was exactly that kind of job, and it shows why having a reliable flatbed towing company on speed dial matters when you drive the mountain corridor.

The Call: A Subaru Stranded Near Jumping Pound

The driver of a white Subaru Forester called us after their vehicle broke down on Highway 1 near Jumping Pound, on the stretch heading toward Kananaskis. The engine had cut out and would not restart, which pointed to a fuel system issue. With vehicles passing at highway speed, sitting on the shoulder of the Trans-Canada is not a place anyone wants to wait longer than they have to.

Our dispatcher confirmed the location, gave the driver a clear ETA, and sent one of our flatbed tow trucks out of Calgary right away.

On Scene: Safe Loading on a Busy Highway Shoulder

Highway shoulder recoveries demand extra care. Our operator positioned the truck to shield the loading zone, activated the light bar for visibility, and winched the Forester onto the flatbed deck. Because the vehicle would not start, the winch did all the work, and the SUV was secured at all four wheels with tie-down straps before we pulled back into traffic.

A fuel issue means the car cannot move under its own power at all, so a flatbed is the only right tool for the job. No dragging, no dollies, no added stress on the drivetrain. The Forester rode the entire way on the deck, exactly as it should.

The Tow: From Jumping Pound Back to Macleod Trail SE

From the breakdown point near Jumping Pound, we brought the Subaru all the way back into the city and dropped it at a repair location near Macleod Trail Southeast. That is a long distance tow covering the western approach to Calgary, and it is a route we run regularly. Drivers heading to Canmore, Banff, or Kananaskis Country break down on this corridor every week, and we are one of the Calgary towing companies that will actually come get you out there.

Why Fuel Issues Leave Drivers Stranded

Fuel related breakdowns are more common than most drivers expect. A failing fuel pump, a clogged fuel filter, a faulty fuel pressure regulator, or simply contaminated fuel can all shut an engine down with little warning. The frustrating part is that these failures rarely announce themselves. The car runs fine one minute and refuses to fire the next. When it happens 40 minutes outside the city, your only real option is a professional tow back to a shop that can diagnose it properly.

Why Choose Flatbed Towing for Highway Recoveries

For any vehicle that cannot run, and especially for all wheel drive vehicles like the Subaru Forester, flatbed towing is the safest method available. The vehicle is fully off the ground, so there is zero wear on the tires, transmission, or AWD system during transport. On a long haul from Kananaskis country back to southeast Calgary, that protection matters.

Stranded on Highway 1? Call BP Towing

Whether you break down near Jumping Pound, Cochrane, Canmore, or anywhere along the Trans-Canada corridor west of the city, BP Towing provides fast, professional flatbed towing back to Calgary. We handle long distance tows, roadside breakdowns, accident recovery, and junk car removal across Calgary and the surrounding highways.

Call BP Towing at 403-991-2265, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. One call and we are on the way.

Here's a real story of how BP Towing helped a customer get their vehicle from downtown Calgary all the way to Didsbury.

The Problem: Stranded 100 KM Away

This customer's Ford EcoSport was parked in downtown Calgary when it simply refused to start. After inspecting the vehicle, our team identified the issue a faulty starter. With the starter not functioning, there was no way to get the vehicle running again without proper repairs. The challenge? The customer needed the vehicle towed roughly 100 kilometers away to Didsbury, Alberta well outside the range of a typical local tow. This is exactly the kind of situation where professional towing calgary services become invaluable.

How BP Towing Handled It

Our team carefully loaded the Ford EcoSport onto our flatbed tow truck, securing it properly for the long haul ahead. The customer rode along with us as a passenger, allowing them to see their vehicle safely delivered to its final destination. The drive from Calgary to Didsbury took about one hour, and the entire trip went smoothly from start to finish. We safely dropped off the vehicle exactly where the customer needed it, with zero issues along the way. This is what reliable long-distance towing looks like.

A Smooth, Stress-Free Experience

Despite the distance, the customer's experience was calm and hassle-free thanks to our team's professionalism. Long-distance towing can feel stressful, but with the right team handling it, it doesn't have to be. What sets BP Towing apart is our commitment to treating every tow whether it's a quick local pickup or a 100-kilometer haul with the same level of care and attention.

Why BP Towing Is Trusted for Long Distance Towing

  • Experienced with local and long-distance towing across Alberta
  • Safe, secure flatbed transport for all vehicle types
  • Passenger-friendly service ride along with your vehicle
  • Transparent, reliable service from pickup to drop-off
  • Fast response times for emergency situations
  • Fully insured and professional drivers

Whether you're dealing with a dead starter, engine failure, or any breakdown, and whether you're in Calgary or anywhere else in Canada, BP Towing is ready to get you and your vehicle where you need to go.

Call us now: 403-991-2265

Yes, BP Towing provides long-distance towing services throughout Alberta, including towns like Didsbury and beyond, in addition to local towing within Calgary. We handle tows ranging from 50 kilometers to over 200 kilometers across the province.

Q2: How much does long-distance towing cost?

Pricing depends on the distance traveled and vehicle type. Contact BP Towing directly at 403-991-2265 for an accurate quote based on your specific situation. We provide transparent pricing with no hidden fees.

Yes, in most cases customers are welcome to ride along as a passenger, just like in this story, so you can be there when your vehicle is safely delivered. This gives you peace of mind and keeps you connected to your vehicle throughout the journey.

A faulty starter can result from worn-out components, electrical issues, or battery-related problems. Repeated starting attempts can drain your battery and cause additional damage.

Definitely. Whether you're stranded in Calgary or anywhere else across Canada, BP Towing is available to assist with both short and long-distance towing needs. We have partnerships and capabilities across multiple provinces.

Call us anytime at 403-991-2265 we're available for 24/7 roadside assistance calgary and long-distance towing requests. Our dispatch team responds immediately to all emergency calls.

content.raw:
At BP Towing, most of our towing Calgary calls follow a familiar pattern. A flat tire here, a dead battery there, a car that will not start on a cold morning. But every so often a call comes in that reminds us why we keep our trucks ready around the clock. This is one of those stories.

The Call

The request came in for a pickup at 55 Autumn View SE, right in the heart of the Auburn Bay and Cranston area of southeast Calgary. This part of the city is known for its quiet residential streets, close proximity to South Health Campus, and easy access to Deerfoot Trail and Stoney Trail. It is also a neighborhood we know well, since a good share of our daily calls come from homeowners and businesses across SE Calgary who need fast, reliable roadside assistance.

The vehicle in question was a 2019 Dodge Ram 1500, a big, capable truck that most owners trust to handle almost anything. In this case, though, the owner had driven it through standing water, and the truck did not come out the other side without a fight.

The Problem

Water and modern trucks do not mix well. Today's pickups are loaded with electronic sensors, modules, and computer-controlled drivetrains, and even a short drive through deep water can throw the system into confusion. That is exactly what happened here. After the water crossing, the truck developed an electrical fault, and the transmission would not shift into neutral the normal way.

For our driver, this meant the job could not be treated as a simple hookup and go. Loading a vehicle that will not shift into neutral is a real hazard if it is not handled correctly. Forcing a locked drivetrain onto a flatbed can damage the transmission, the driveline, or the tow equipment itself, and it can also put the driver at risk.

How We Handled It

Our driver arrived at the Autumn View SE address, assessed the truck, and confirmed that the automatic shifter was not responding because of the water related electrical issue. Rather than risk further damage, he worked the truck into neutral manually, using the mechanical release built into the transmission for exactly this kind of situation. It takes a bit more time and a bit more care, but it is the right way to protect the vehicle.

Once the truck was safely in neutral, it was loaded onto the flatbed and secured for transport. The destination was South Trail Chrysler, the Ram dealership on the south side of Calgary, where the technicians could run proper diagnostics on the electrical system and get the truck back to full working order.

From pickup at Autumn View SE to drop off at the dealership, the whole job was handled without a single scrape or scuff on the truck. That is the standard we hold ourselves to on every call, but it matters even more when a vehicle already has an underlying issue that needs to be protected during transport.

Why This Kind of Job Matters

Not every tow is a simple breakdown on the side of the road. Some jobs, like this one, require a driver who actually understands how vehicles work, not just how to hook up a strap and pull. Knowing how to manually release a transmission, understanding why water intrusion causes electrical faults, and knowing how to load a compromised vehicle without adding more damage are things that come from experience, not luck.

This is also a good reminder for Calgary drivers. SE Calgary sees its share of heavy rain and pooling water on roads and parking areas, especially during the summer storm season. Even a short stretch of standing water can be deeper than it looks, and a modern truck's electronics are far more sensitive than older models. If your vehicle has been through water and something feels off, whether that is a warning light, a shifting problem, or strange electrical behavior, the safest move is to stop driving it and call for towing Calgary drivers can trust, rather than risk further damage on the road.

What BP Towing Offers Across Calgary

This job is a good example of the kind of towing Calgary service we provide across the city and the surrounding communities, including Auburn Bay, Cranston, and the broader SE Calgary area. Our services include:

  • Light duty and flatbed towing for cars, trucks, and SUVs
  • Dealership and service center drop offs, like this South Trail Chrysler delivery
  • Roadside assistance for lockouts, dead batteries, and flat tires
  • Accident recovery and safe vehicle transport
  • Towing for vehicles with mechanical or electrical faults that need extra care during loading

We operate with a simple goal on every call: get the vehicle where it needs to go safely, without adding to the owner's problems.

What the Customer Had to Say

After the truck was safely dropped off, the owner shared this feedback with us:

"My Ram wouldn't shift after driving through some water and I honestly did not know what to do. The driver from BP Towing showed up quickly, knew right away how to get it into neutral without forcing anything, and got it to South Trail Chrysler without a scratch. Really appreciated the professionalism. Would call them again without hesitation."

Reviews like this are exactly why we do what we do. A stressful situation for a truck owner turned into a smooth, worry-free experience because the right driver showed up with the right knowledge.

Need a Tow in Calgary?

If your vehicle has an electrical issue, will not shift properly, or has been through water, do not take chances with it. Call BP Towing for fast, careful, and experienced towing Calgary service anywhere in the city and the surrounding areas.

Visit us at bptowingservice.ca or give us a call for immediate roadside assistance.
